slug: 女装后我在修行界当白月光
content_zh:
东洲，无岐山。
山峰如黛，层林叠翠，群峰环绕，奇松怪柏，从上到下远望是一片碧色的林海，连成一片，仿佛是水墨画里淋漓尽致尽染的春色。
“啊啊啊！有妖怪啊。”
然而，一声惨叫打破了周围静谧的氛围，一股浓浓如墨色般的妖气，迅速从半山腰处弥漫开，腐蚀着周围的花草，乌云滚滚，飞沙走石，简直触目惊心。
一条十几米长的浑身青黑鳞片的巨蟒，赤目獠牙，嘶嘶作响，张开血盆大口几欲噬人。这条成了精的蟒蛇，蜿蜒的身躯拍打着周围的树木发出重重响声，所过之处山石碎裂。
发出惊呼的是一个穿着粗布衣服背着箩筐的姑娘，是附近村落里的一个村姑，这次上山来采些山货或者草药补贴家用。
她原本消瘦的脸上此刻面色苍白，看着这条吃了不知多少人命的蟒蛇感到十分绝望。
挣扎着想逃走但是凡人遇到妖气只觉得头昏眼花，仓皇之间被断裂的树枝绊倒在地，划破膝盖，血流不止。
此刻从树上忽然跳下一个俊美少年，衣袂翩跹，身如轻燕，他手持长剑快似惊鸿的朝着蛇妖那巨大的眼窝里刺进去，双脚一蹬，凌空落下。
“咻咻咻”
数道剑气落下，银光闪烁，这些攻击最后汇聚在一起将这条十几米长的青黑巨蟒连腰斩断，伴随着这庞然大物忽然倒下，是同样被压碎和折断的不少树木。
收回长剑的少年和散落在地上的蟒蛇的尸首，渺小的身影和如小山高的蛇首形成鲜明对比。
采药姑娘何曾见过这般惊心动魄的场面，这一幕恐怕会深深烙印在她的心里，几十年也不会忘记。
少年年岁不大，约莫十三、四岁，背着剑匣，腰系葫芦，打扮随心，看起来有几分逍遥不羁。他取下腰间系着的葫芦拧开倒出一股涓流。
那水落在采药姑娘的因为摔倒还流着血的膝盖上，顿时血止住了，伤口飞快的愈合变成了一道狭长的疤痕，还连伤口的痕迹也看不到了。
这般神奇的景象惊的这个采药的村姑赶忙跪倒在地磕头感激的说道：
“感谢仙人救命之恩。”
“我可不是什么仙人，只是个修行者，这山上的精怪被我铲除不少，不过还是有一些危险，你还是早点回家吧。”
少年摆手摇头笑着说道，随其纵身一跃，跳上树梢，几个兔起鹘落之间便消失得无影无踪。
他的名字叫林渊，是一个因为意外倒霉死亡的穿越玩家，幸运的是穿越的世界是他之前玩过的一款玄幻游戏，他穿到了游戏开服的十年前。

这款是虚拟度百分之百在前世刚出现就大受欢迎的玄幻类型游戏，受到很多人追捧，林渊正是其中是玩家之一，也是排行榜上鼎鼎有名的高手。
“没想到回来路上还能够遇到有蛇妖，让我看看这次收获了什么。”
他打开系统面板，看到了上面显示已经完成临时任务【诛杀蛇妖】和【救人】，看到到账的两千经验值和一瓶气血丹。
林渊穿越过来由于绑定了游戏系统，这段时间在无岐山勤勤恳恳的刷怪，方圆八百里的孤魂野鬼和妖怪都化作了他的经验值。
考虑到自己已经穿越到了一个强者可以摘星拿月，横渡虚空的玄幻世界。
那么等级自然是越高越好，经验自然是越多越好。
如果到了20级的话，需要拜入师门，然后学习门派功法才可以继续升级，同时系统还会奖励惊喜宝箱。林渊都想一直待着新手村升满级后才下山，当个十里坡剑神他不香吗？
拜师的话，由于林渊穿过来的时候坐下的地点是东洲的一个偏僻边缘的大齐王朝里，周围基本上都是些不入品的门派，便是王朝里最好的一个也就是一个五品宗门。
宗门分为一到九品，九品最佳，一品最低，至于九品之上则是道统级势力，道统之上则是高不可攀的圣地。
对于一个前世曾经是天尊境界的玩家林渊来说，拜入那种五品宗门对他来说简直浪费时间。
而且如果拜师过后退出宗门的惩罚比较严重，扣除巨额经验以及还有掉声望值，所以选择一个好的宗门是非常有必要的。
可是东洲大齐王朝这个地方实在太偏僻了，好处是这里没有太多危险，不像中州高手如云，坏处是想找好的宗门非常困难。
原本林渊是准备离开大齐王朝去东洲的其他厉害的宗门拜师，虽然路程比较远可能会遇到不少困难，没想到一个惊喜从天而降。
他居然遇到了因为和妖王大战身受重伤不得已空间传送的颜清雪，这位太阴圣地的长老落在无岐山养伤，并且身中剧毒。
如果不是发现了隐蔽阵法的蛛丝马迹和系统任务的提示，林渊还真没有想的这么偏僻的角落里居然能够遇到圣地的人，而且还是长老。
要知道太阴圣地即使在高手如云的中州也是可望不可及的存在，那可是出过几位横推一世的大帝们的绝世宗门，十大圣地里排行前三。
content_en:
Dongzhou, Wuqishan.
The peaks are as dark as black, with layers of green forests, surrounded by peaks, and strange pines and cypresses. From top to bottom, you can see a sea of ​​green forests, connected together, as if they are vividly dyed spring colors in an ink painting.
"Ahhh! There is a monster."
However, a scream broke the quiet atmosphere around him, and a thick, ink-colored demonic aura quickly spread from the mountainside, corroding the surrounding flowers and plants. Dark clouds rolled in, and sand and rocks flew, which was simply shocking.
A giant python that was more than ten meters long and covered in green and black scales, with red eyes and fangs, hissed, and opened its bloody mouth to bite people. This imprisoned python's winding body slapped the surrounding trees, making heavy noises, and rocks shattered wherever it passed.
The person who exclaimed was a girl wearing coarse clothes and carrying a basket on her back. She was a village girl from a nearby village. This time she went up the mountain to collect some mountain products or herbs to support her family.
Her originally thin face turned pale now, and she felt very desperate looking at this python that had taken countless lives.
He struggled to escape, but a mortal would only feel dizzy when encountering the evil spirit. In a hurry, he tripped over a broken branch and fell to the ground, cutting his knee and bleeding.
At this moment, a handsome young man suddenly jumped out of the tree. His clothes were flowing and his body was as light as a swallow. He held a long sword and stabbed it into the snake demon's huge eye socket as fast as a thunderbolt. He kicked off his feet and fell into the air.
"Boooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooh"
Several rays of sword energy fell, silver light flashed, and these attacks finally gathered together to cut off the ten-meter-long green and black python at the waist. As the behemoth suddenly fell, many trees were also crushed and broken.
The young man withdrew his sword and the python corpses scattered on the ground. The small figure was in sharp contrast with the snake head as high as a small mountain.
The herb picking girl had never seen such a thrilling scene before. This scene will probably be deeply imprinted in her heart and she will not forget it for decades.
The young man is young, about thirteen or fourteen years old. He carries a sword box on his back and a gourd on his waist. He is dressed casually and looks a bit carefree. He took off the gourd tied around his waist, twisted it, and poured out a trickle of water.
The water fell on the herb collector's knee, which was still bleeding from the fall. The bleeding stopped immediately, and the wound healed quickly and turned into a long and narrow scar, and even the trace of the wound was no longer visible.
Such a miraculous sight shocked the village girl collecting herbs and she quickly knelt down on the ground and kowtowed and said gratefully:
"Thank you Immortal for saving my life."
"I'm not an immortal, I'm just a practitioner. I've eradicated a lot of the monsters on this mountain, but there are still some dangers. You'd better go home early."
The young man waved his hands and shook his head and said with a smile, then he jumped up to the treetop, and a few rabbits disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.
His name is Lin Yuan, a time-traveling player who died due to an accident. Fortunately, the world he traveled to was a fantasy game he had played before, and he traveled to ten years before the game was launched.
This is a fantasy game with 100% virtuality that was very popular when it first appeared in the previous life. It is sought after by many people. Lin Yuan is one of the players and is also a well-known master on the ranking list.
"I didn't expect to encounter a snake demon on the way back. Let me see what I gained this time."
He opened the system panel and saw that it showed that he had completed the temporary tasks [Kill the Snake Demon] and [Rescue People], and saw that he had received two thousand experience points and a bottle of Qi and Blood Pill.
Lin Yuan traveled through time and was bound to the game system. During this time, he diligently spawned monsters in Wuqi Mountain. The lonely ghosts and monsters within a radius of 800 miles turned into his experience points.
Considering that he has traveled to a fantasy world where strong men can reach for the stars and the moon, and cross the void.
Then the higher the level, the better, and the more experience, the better.
If you reach level 20, you need to join the sect and learn the martial arts before you can continue to upgrade. At the same time, the systemSurprise treasure chests will also be awarded. Lin Yuan even wanted to wait until Novice Village reached the full level before going down the mountain. Wouldn't it be great for him to be the Shilipo Sword God?
In terms of apprenticeship, since the place where Lin Yuan was sitting when he came over was in the Daqi Dynasty on the remote edge of Dongzhou, surrounded by basically unworthy sects, it was the best one in the dynasty, which was a fifth-grade sect.
The sect is divided into grades one to nine, with grade nine being the best and grade one being the lowest. Above the ninth grade are Taoist-level forces, and above Taoism are unattainable holy lands.
For Lin Yuan, a player who was in the realm of Tianzun in his previous life, joining that kind of fifth-grade sect is a waste of time for him.
Moreover, the penalty for quitting a sect after becoming a disciple is severe, with a huge amount of experience deducted and a loss of reputation points, so it is very necessary to choose a good sect.
But the Dongzhou Daqi Dynasty is too remote. The advantage is that there are not many dangers here, unlike Zhongzhou where there are so many masters. The disadvantage is that it is very difficult to find a good sect.
Originally, Lin Yuan was planning to leave the Daqi Dynasty and go to Dongzhou to become a disciple of another powerful sect. Although the journey was long and he might encounter many difficulties, he didn't expect a surprise to fall from the sky.
He actually met Yan Qingxue, who was seriously injured in the battle with the Demon King and had to teleport. This elder of the Taiyin Holy Land fell to Wuqi Mountain to recuperate from his injuries, and was poisoned.
If he hadn't discovered the clues about the hidden formation and the system mission prompts, Lin Yuan would never have expected that he could meet people from the Holy Land in such a remote corner, and they were also elders.
You must know that the Taiyin Holy Land is an existence that is out of reach even in Zhongzhou where there are many masters. It is a peerless sect that has produced several great emperors and ranks among the top three in the top ten Holy Lands.
